name: Ruined Kegs
label: Quest
description: Ruined Kegs: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The rotten eggs have been successfully placed inside the keg. Future batches of ale from the Southshore Inn are sure to be ruined!
You should now report back to Darkcaller Yanka at the Wickerman Festival in Tirisfal Glade and report your success.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, success! You've shown true Hallow's End spirit - FORSAKEN spirit, I should say!
I revel in the fact that Southshore must now feast on bad ale or go without! As for you, take these treats. I believe you will find good use for them!
